definitions.explanation: Acting or speaking without thinking carefully about the consequences. Describes careless, hasty behavior.

examples.japanese: {軽|かる}はずみな{発言|はつげん}をしてしまった。
{軽|かる}はずみな{行動|こうどう}は{慎|つつし}んでください。
{軽|かる}はずみに{約束|やくそく}してしまい、あとで{後悔|こうかい}した。
examples.english: I thoughtlessly made a promise and regretted it later.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a な-adjective ({軽|かる}はずみな〜) and as an adverb ({軽|かる}はずみに〜). Often used when criticizing or warning about impulsive behavior. Can also be written {軽弾|かるはず}み, though kana is more common for はずみ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軽|かる}はずみな{発言|はつげん} (careless remark)
- {軽|かる}はずみな{行動|こうどう} (rash behavior)
- {軽|かる}はずみに{約束|やくそく}する (to promise rashly)
